newsitem.title: GERMANY: Welteke favours Bonn converting debt to euro in 99.
newsitem.headline: Welteke favours Bonn converting debt to euro in 99.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke said on Tuesday he welcomed comments from a top German finance ministry official saying he would recommend that Bonn convert its debt to the new euro in 1999.
"We in Frankfurt would welcome it if the finance ministry decided to convert all tradeable outstanding debt into the euro," Welteke said.
He added that the conversion would help to create a liquid and deep eurobond market.

Juergen Stark, the state secretary in the German finance ministry, said earlier on Tuesday that he would recommend to German Finance Minister Theo Waigel that all tradeable federal government debt be converted to the euro at its start in 1999.
